admin-card: Link-warning domain rules and a read-only view of what a member sees.
macro-message-placeholder: Optional message to the author. Use {{user}} and {{reason}} in saved responses.
out-deny: This site has been flagged as unsafe
out-deny-body: Moderators have flagged {{host}}. Only continue if you know what you are opening.
out-invalid: That is not a web link we can open.
out-new: You are about to visit a site that is new here
out-new-body: {{host}} has only recently started appearing on RMH Studios, so we have not seen much of it yet.
pileon-active-body: Only people you follow can reply until {{time}}.
pileon-failed: That did not work. Try again.
pileon-missing: We could not find that notice.
pileon-offer-body: Your post is getting a burst of replies from people who do not follow you. You can limit replies to people you follow for the next 24 hours. It switches back by itself.
reconsider-body: This reply may come across as hostile to the person reading it. You can edit it, or post it as it is.
rules-intro: Links to blocked domains, and to domains that only just started appearing, open a warning page first. Allowed domains skip the new-domain warning.
slow-active: Slow mode is on ({{seconds}}s between messages)
slow-new-account: Chat is paused for brand-new accounts while the room is busy.
slow-wait: Slow mode: wait {{seconds}}s to send again
viewas-feed: Top of their For You feed
viewas-intro: See a member’s mutes, blocks, plan and the top of their For You feed. Read-only, and every lookup is recorded in the audit log.
